questions.question: For the deploy follow-up, what should 'separate thread' mean?

options.label: Just the ticket
options.description: Create the follow-up ticket as Todo on the board and stop. You'll start a thread for it later when you're actually ready to deploy. (Nothing to run in a thread right now since deploys are on hold.)

options.label: Ticket + start thread now
options.description: Also create a new worktree/branch and claim the new ticket (start-work flow) so it's an active In-Progress thread immediately — even though the deploy itself stays blocked.
